newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank of Portugal says economy accelerated Q3.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Portugal says economy accelerated Q3.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal said in its latest report that domestic economic growth had accelerated in the third quarter.
The Bank uses a series of indicators for output and consumption which it is does not quantify publicly.
"The indicator...(for) commerce, industry and construction showed an accelerating trend visible since the start of 1996," it said.
The Bank said most indicators also pointed to an acceleration in private consumption in 1996.
